record.paper_title: The Branch-Cut Cosmology: evidences and open questions
record.original_question: What is the correct and more internally consistent way to map the evolution of the cut-planes in branch-cut cosmology, so that the time development of the model across its Riemann-sheet structure is described coherently?

evidence.quote: Other aspects to be investigated refer to a more consistent evolution mapping of the cut-planes

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider a cosmological model in which the cosmic scale factor is analytically continued to a complex variable and represented on a multi-sheeted Riemann surface obtained by introducing branch cuts in the complex plane (a "branch-cut cosmology"). In such a model, the physical evolution is parameterized by a complex time variable whose trajectory traverses successive cut-planes (sheets) connected across branch cuts, and the usual real cosmological time emerges as a projection of this trajectory.

Problem: Formulate a coherent and internally consistent prescription for mapping the temporal evolution across the cut-plane / Riemann-sheet structure of such a model. Specifically:

(a) Define precisely the complex time variable, the location and orientation of the branch cuts, and the rule by which a continuous evolution trajectory passes from one Riemann sheet to the next.

(b) Show that the resulting evolution map is single-valued and continuous in the relevant physical observables (scale factor, Hubble parameter, energy densities), and that it reduces to standard cosmological evolution in the appropriate real-time limit.

(c) Verify that the prescription is consistent with the Einstein field equations (or their analytic continuation) on each sheet and with the matching conditions across each branch cut.

Provide such a prescription, or prove that no such globally consistent evolution mapping exists under stated minimal assumptions.
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as an explicitly open direction for further investigation within the branch-cut cosmology framework. No subsequent work has been identified that provides a definitive, internally consistent prescription for evolution mapping across the Riemann-sheet/cut-plane structure of the model, so the problem appears to remain open.
